title: standardize-commit-hooks-and-staged-ci-to-reduce-noise-and-accelerate-tests
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: Our CI is doing full lint/test runs for every push which increases queue time and developer feedback latency. This PR introduces standardized client-side commit hooks, a commit message linter, and a staged-run strategy in CI so only touched packages/files trigger the heavy checks. Goal: faster local feedback, fewer flaky CI runs, and a simpler path for contributors. Changes: 1) Add commitlint config and a lightweight commit-msg hook (commitlint@17.x) to enforce Conventional Commits; 2) Add Husky + simple install script for developers and a fallback server-side check for merges; 3) Add lint-staged rules for JS/TS/Python formatting and fast unit test shims for changed packages; 4) Introduce a new composite GitHub Action (actions/ci-staged-run) that computes affected packages via repo-shed and runs only the relevant lint/test jobs; 5) Replace legacy ./scripts/pre-commit.sh with node-based installer and remove deprecated bash wrappers; 6) Update docs/CONTRIBUTING.md and onboarding scripts for the new flow. Rollout plan: install hooks opt-in on repo upgrade, server-side commit-msg check enforced on protected branches, staged CI enabled behind a feature flag for 2 weeks then flipped on. Backwards compatibility: if developer opts out of hooks, CI still enforces commitlint before merge. Testing & validation: local install smoke tested on macOS and Linux containers; CI matrix includes one job to validate full-suite to catch regressions. Checklist: - [x] commitlint config and ruleset added | - [x] husky + install script added | - [x] composite action for staged CI implemented | - [x] docs updated and onboarding notes added | - [x] release notes drafted | - [x] manual staging rollout completed on internal repos | Related work: ENG-2534 tracks staged CI infra, ENG-2599 tracks commit policy adoption. Context: reduces queue pressure on CI and complements previous work on CI cache keying and test-slicing by narrowing work per push.
commits: feat(ci): add commitlint rule set and config
chore(ci): add husky and install script, remove legacy pre-commit.sh
feat(ci): implement actions/ci-staged-run composite and affected-packages detector
refactor(scripts): migrate pre-commit installer to node, add idempotent logic
docs: update CONTRIBUTING.md and onboarding notes
reviews: Liam O'Connor (reviewer): Please ensure the composite action produces deterministic cache keys; observed a race the first run. Author reply: added a lockfile-based key and pinned the action sha, see action.yml.
Marina Chen (reviewer): The dev install flow needs a no-op for CI runners. Author reply: installer now detects CI env and exits early.
Diego Ramirez (approver): Verified the staged detector on a large monorepo workload, latency dropped ~45% for lint jobs. Approved.
release_notes: Introduce commit hooks and staged CI: enforce commitlint on merges; add Husky and commit-msg hook; staged-run CI composite reduces work per push; docs updated. No breaking changes.
notes_for_maintainers: Feature gated: flip 'staged-ci' feature flag in repo settings after one-week observation. Teams should run `node tools/husky/install.js` once; CI will reject merges that don't conform to commitlint rules until enforcement is toggled.
